references.text: Both texts illustrate God's sovereignty over human plans by turning an expected curse into an irrevocable blessing.
The verse describes the execution of the deception, which directly leads to Isaac's shocked realization and confirmation of the blessing in the source verse.
Repeats and reinforces the theological parallel from Numbers 23:11 regarding God's ability to transform a planned curse into an unchangeable blessing.
Describes the very moment when the blessing was pronounced, which is the direct cause of Isaac's shocked confirmation in the source verse.
